decisionsTitle: «În direct pe YouTube»: one tick in «Setări» → «Aspect» puts «Suntem în direct» under the header on every page, with the broadcast's link
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-29, from the phone, after the OBS audio page (`docs/LIVESTREAM-AUDIO.md`):** «Also I want on the website a notification that we are live streaming.»

**Decision.** A club setting, «În direct pe YouTube», as a card on «Setări» → «Aspect» beside «Pagina principală» (§714): a real tick box «Suntem în direct — arată anunțul pe site» (§766, never a switch) and one box, «Adresa transmisiei pe YouTube». Saved behind the §384 question, Administrator-only at the page, the action and the service (§450), audited as `live_stream.changed` with «on <address>» / «off» as its before and after, one `platform_settings` row (`liveStream`, §100), no migration. While it is on, every page — the backoffice too — carries one slim bar under the sticky header, in the flow like the new-build notice (§210): a red dot, «Suntem în direct pe YouTube» and the one link «Urmărește transmisia» to the address, a 44-pixel target. Off, nothing is drawn and the header is byte for byte what it was. The header reads it through the public cache's `settings` tag (§333), which the save expires; the last good copy, else the default, when the database is away — a bar that says the club is live never appears because a read failed.

**The address.** `https` on YouTube's own hosts (`youtube.com`, `www.`, `m.`, `youtu.be`), any path, kept as typed and trimmed: the broadcast's own address or the channel's «live» page (`/@canal/live`), which always leads to the current broadcast and so never has to be changed before a race. The address is kept while the notice is off, so the next broadcast is one tick and one save. On with no address, or any address that is not YouTube's, is refused naming the box: a «Suntem în direct» that leads nowhere is a dead end, and a bar on every page may lead only to the broadcast.

**Refused.** *An embedded player on every page* — it would load YouTube with every page view, which the privacy notice says happens only on a press (§69), and cost every visitor the header's budget (`AGENTS.md` §1.5); the bar is words and a plain link. *Reading the live state from YouTube itself* — a key, a quota and a poll from every page for a thing that happens a few times a year; the person who starts the stream ticks one box. *A bar the visitor can dismiss* — client state for one line that is gone the moment the broadcast ends. *An Organizer's switch* — the tick is a club setting like the rest of «Aspect»; the person streaming on race day is an Administrator, and widening it is one line in `canManageClubSettings`'s caller if the club asks.

**Consequences.** `appearance/domain/live-stream.ts` (pure: `youtubeAddress`, the schema, `parseLiveStream`, `describeLiveStream`), `appearance/live-stream.ts` (read, update, audit, expiry), `public-cache/reads.ts#cachedLiveStream`, `shared/ui/LiveStreamNotice.tsx` drawn by `SiteHeader`, `appearance/ui/LiveStreamPanel.tsx` on «Aspect» with `updateLiveStreamAction`, the glyph `liveStream`, the catalogues' `Admin.liveStream.*`, `Admin.confirm.liveStream*` and `Site.live.*`. Tests: `tests/unit/appearance/live-stream.test.ts`, `live-stream-notice.test.ts`, `tests/integration/appearance/live-stream.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/live-stream.spec.ts`. The OBS page's checklist says when to tick it and when to untick it.
changelogLine: - **«Suntem în direct pe YouTube»** — one tick in «Setări» → «Aspect» → «În direct pe YouTube», with the broadcast's address, puts a slim bar with the link under the header on every page; unticked, it is gone. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the club's «În direct pe YouTube» setting on with a YouTube address, when any page renders at any width, then one bar under the header carries «Suntem în direct pe YouTube» and one 44-pixel link to that address, a plain anchor that embeds and loads nothing from YouTube; with the setting off, or unreadable, or the database away, nothing is drawn and the header is unchanged (2026-10-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Only an Administrator (canManageClubSettings) saves the live-broadcast notice, asserted at the page, the action and the service; on is refused without an https address on a YouTube host, naming the box, and every save writes one `live_stream.changed` audit row and expires the public cache's settings (2026-10-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
